name: ProfileEvents
comment: ProfileEvents that measure different metrics. The description of them could be found in the table system.events

name: databases
comment: Names of the databases present in the query.

name: event_time_microseconds
comment: Query starting time with microseconds precision.

name: is_initial_query
comment: Query type. Possible values: 1 — query was initiated by the client, 0 — query was initiated by another query as part of distributed query execution.

name: normalized_query_hash
comment: A numeric hash value, such as it is identical for queries differ only by values of literals.

name: query_start_time_microseconds
comment: Start time of query execution with microsecond precision.

name: type
comment: Type of an event that occurred when executing the query. Values: `QueryStart` — successful start of query execution, `QueryFinish` — successful end of query execution, `ExceptionBeforeStart` — exception before the start of query execution, `ExceptionWhileProcessing` — exception during the query execution.
